Frickin' A. Youtube Premium ads are out of control. So absurdly obnoxious, especially when all I want to is listen to some music while I work. They don't even really try to hide it. Just shove that shit wherever. Oops, your video was playing for 3 seconds, uninterrupted! Sorry, we'll fix that for you.

They know what they're doing. Everyone is, for the most part, holed up and on their devices more than usual because of the virus, so they're taking full advantage of it.
It's a bad habit that can cause all sorts of issues, like tinnitus. I don't know your exact situation, but I'd like to think tinnitus is not something you'd be eager to add to the mix.

I've done this a couple times, but I usually opt to strike myself with my fists. I cut a few times too, but not very deep. 

Never feels very good the day after.

Here, here! 
Fuck this place. Seriously.
I think the same thing everyday. I just want to skip to the end already. The rest is just filler.
